method: Six independent built-in image_gen edits, without postprocess filters. A–D are conservative treatments; E/F relax small-contour locking while retaining seated pose, camera and large object relationships. Candidates, not hand-painted final assets.
userRequested: Reduce AI-looking finish while retaining composition and continuity with the playable haven; provide multiple choices if generated.

variants.name: 整簇像素
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit image 1 into one finished alternative game-title background. Image 1 is the EXACT composition/geometry/identity target. Image 2 is the ACTUAL playable game, a style continuity reference only: do not adopt its camera or rearrange the map. Output 1536x1024 (3:2), one image, no text or UI.
LOCK: unchanged camera angle, crop, object placements and silhouettes. Keep the small seated worker at the stove on the right-hand fragment of ruined masonry, forearms towards the warmth; dark modest helmet, work coat, rectangular backpack, small shoulder lamp. Keep identical sitting pose, body size, stove identity and its distance to the figure. Keep angular open restraining frame around irregular cold grey-green energy at right; it is contained pollution with volume, not a portal. Preserve tilted enormous book galleries and fading structural fragments in the chasm on left, thickness and support on the right of the occupied ledge, black menu space on left. No new subjects, lanterns, stairs, vegetation, magical decorations or gold ornaments. Keep subdued ash/charcoal stone, dark iron, sparse controlled grey-green contamination and small muted amber furnace light. The core remains strongest light. Do not brighten the whole scene or turn it blue/green. Do not erase the distant architecture.
The defect to fix is synthetic uniformly detailed texture and smooth 3D-looking shading dressed as pixels. REDRAW the image with deliberate marks, edge decisions, clusters and sparse material-specific accents. This must visibly change the drawing language, not just rescale, apply a mosaic/filter, sharpen, blur, add grain or tint the old image. Stone weight comes from big planes and a few mid-sized broken joints; iron comes from narrow chosen edge/reflection groups; cloth from 2-3 broad folded masses. Preserve the ordinary human scale and intimate rest. Title art should still cut honestly to the actual game.

DRAWING APPROACH A: meticulous hand-placed pixel game background with chunky connected pixel clusters and disciplined edges. Conceive a 768x512 native pixel canvas enlarged exactly 2x to 1536x1024. Every mark follows this consistent visible grid. Use about 32 authored colours, shared slate/ash ramps, 3-5 steps per material with subtle hue shifts. Build stair-step silhouette rhythms deliberately; interiors mainly solid shaped colour islands rather than scattered single-pixel noise. No anti-aliasing outside the 2x grid. A 20-pixel-wide stone has 2-4 meaningful chips, NOT a hundred pinholes. No checkerboard dithering everywhere. Keep finished rich forms and selective fine book spines around lit focal areas, simplify shadowed books into grouped slots. Energy has a few interwoven translucent-looking pixel masses and offset filaments, not a smooth cottonball. Distinct lost-and-found edges, no uniform outline, no ambient-occlusion 3D sheen, no fuzzy bloom. Air uses dark stepped large overlapping value shapes. It should look painstakingly drawn in a sprite editor, not mechanically pixelated.

variants.name: 粗像素概括
variants.prompt:
Redraw reference image 1 as a genuinely DIFFERENT hand-authored pixel illustration, not a texture filter over it. Reference 1 is ONLY A COMPOSITION GUIDE: retain this camera angle, small seated helmeted worker warming hands at rectangular iron stove at lower right, same relative positions and proportions of the rightmost bowed restraining core (irregular grey-green contained energy, not portal), inhabited ruined ledge supported offscreen right, left tilted giant library wings over deep vertical void. Left remains quiet menu space. Reference 2 shows the actual playable game identities and restrained detail levels. Do not copy its camera. Keep mood ash/charcoal, minute amber warmth and only contaminated objects grey-green. No text, labels, additions or UI. The human's seated pose and the elevated diagonal camera are approved; keep these. Preserve large placements, NOT every pixel-level contour or tiny surface mark. The task demands a fresh drawing, NOT meticulous imitation of the supplied digital painting. Output 1536x1024, 3:2.
STRONG STYLE CHANGE: construct the entire image at a native 384x256 pixel-art resolution, then present it at 4x nearest-neighbour (1536x1024). Every smallest mark is a crisp uniform 4x4 square. No subpixel line, no anti-aliasing, no high-resolution texture. Seated figure is only approximately 16 native pixels tall: readable dark helmet, tiny pale lamp point, brown coat plane, backpack rectangle and bent knees—do not squeeze realistic anatomy/face detail inside it. Use 24 deliberately chosen colours total with shared ramps. Achieve richness from contour design, overlapping big architectural silhouettes, interrupted thick masonry planes, rhythmic book-slot clusters, strongly selected reflected light, NOT little flecks everywhere. Stone floor slabs should be mostly QUIET FLAT shaped masses, cracks only where structural. Opaque compact 3-colour firelight patches, broad stepped shadow masses, broken icy green mass inside the core with 3-4 jagged internal gaps. Massive distant book gallery simplified to less than half the reference detail. No gradient, blur, smooth fog, checkerboard blanket or dithering texture. Sophisticated finished 16-bit-style dark game illustration: reduce resolution while retaining architecture weight, atmosphere and composition. Dramatic clear drawing should read immediately as pixel art rather than a sharpened 3D render.
